baseline.paper_ref: Historical reproduced cost0.03013518466351807; not a new measured reference.

conversion.constraint_limitation: Original task omits definitions of three external constraints; reproduce the three explicit protocol checks in .repro/hard/eval_cost.py and report this scope.

allowed_changes: Optimizer/search, initialization, numerical surrogate, parameter proposals and implementation for the same three-variable physical objective.
Candidate numerical computation may change but cannot replace judge Hamiltonian/evaluation; Nelder-Mead and its stopping heuristics are baseline choices.
When retaining the supplied Nelder-Mead search, changing only adaptive=False, the default 5% initial simplex or maxfev=20 does not count as a method improvement.
fixed_contract: Optimize h, mu_1 and mu_b of the specified Super-Ising Hamiltonian for the frozen 14-operator relative RMS spectral cost at N_mf=9.
Original interacting Hamiltonian, t=1.5/U=.25/g=1, required observable convention and N_mf=9 physical problem.
Same 14 bootstrap references, state/operator assignment, analytic optimal lambda, eigenpair/spin validity and RMS formula.
Existing five-calibration/at-most-40-local-case protocol; frozen ED independently recomputes parameter cases. Originally unnamed external constraints remain unverified.
Supplied data/splits, evaluation metric, trusted evaluator and lawful information access.
method_freedom_review.budget_policy: agent overall deadline; separate overall formal replay budget
forbidden_substitutions: Change Hamiltonian family, fixed couplings, physical size, bootstrap target, operator selection or cost normalization.
Submit spectra/scores instead of parameter cases, omit required calibration or certify undefined constraints as passed.
Replace full N9 with N4 smoke or use archived solutions instead of actual optimization.
Training or fitting reusable model state or learned preprocessing on validation features or labels, including final train+val refits or validation-based distillation.
Hard-coding (h, mu_1, mu_b) values found during development, as a search start or as a submitted case, does not count as a method improvement.
